name: No error surface appears during a normal session

planSteps.description: Open the app and wait for the initial solve to finish.
Switch through all four tariffs, waiting for the ribbon to redraw after each.
Add a load, then remove it, then press '-' and '+' on the EV charger a few times, waiting for each re-solve.
Verify no error message, error banner, or error panel appears anywhere on the page at any point.
Verify the ribbon, the load rows, and the Outcome section remain rendered and populated throughout, with no blank or missing panel.
Paste the word 'garbage' into the usage textarea and click 'Bill this usage'.
Verify the only error shown is the usage import's own message, and that the rest of the page continues to work.
